subject: MAP and close timeline: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA alignment for Moneta POC
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@monetasystems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@monetasystems.com
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: security & DPA alignment for Redwood POC

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Moneta engineering and security teams are aligned on proceeding to a two-week POC. Before we spin up test traffic we need to lock the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) items for security acceptance so procurement can sign off. I've attached our initial SIG/CAIQ answers and a DPA redline for your legal team.

Quick asks from our side:
- Confirm SOC 2 report availability (latest Type II) and whether we can get an SOC scope matrix (which controls map to data flows).
- DPA redline: preserve the data residency and deletion SLA fields, but we have a few carveouts. Please review DPA_redline_karthik_v2.docx.
- Data retention expectations: for POC we will route synthetic payment tokens and logs. We expect logs retained for 90 days and backups retained per policy; please confirm deletion workflow and proof-of-delete timeline.

Target timeline we discussed:
- MAP agreed and signed: by 2027-05-12
- POC run (two weeks): 2027-05-15 — 2027-05-29
- Evaluation acceptance decision: by 2027-06-02

Can you propose owners and a short MAP with milestones? Also can we schedule a 30-min security intake on Tue 2027-05-04 10:00 PT?

Attachments: Moneta_SIG_Answers_v1.pdf, DPA_redline_karthik_v2.docx

Best,
Emma Jones
Head of Product Security
Moneta Systems
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@monetasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: security & DPA alignment for Redwood POC

Emma — thanks for the note and the attachments. Looking through the SIG answers and the DPA redline. Quick response and a proposed MAP skeleton below; I copied Marissa (CS lead) and Connor (legal ops) to own the procurement path and drive the DocuSign.

Proposed MAP (skeleton) — owners and target dates:
- SOC 2 evidence packet (owner: Karthik) — deliver by 2027-05-03. Includes latest Type II, control mapping doc, and contact for auditor.
- SIG/CAIQ detailed Q&A (owner: Moneta / Emma) — confirm any open items by 2027-05-06. Redwood will produce clarifying notes for any "partial" answers.
- DPA finalization (owner: Connor O'Brien) — redline review complete by 2027-05-10; target signature by 2027-05-12.
- Data retention & deletion proof (owner: Marissa Cole / Redwood ops) — retention windows for logs/backups and deletion runbook by 2027-05-08. Proof-of-delete workflow (API call + audit log) to be demonstrated during POC.
- Security intake call & tech walkthrough — schedule Tue 2027-05-04 10:00 PT (I proposed; let me know if that works).

Clarifying questions from our infra team:
1) EU residency requirement: do you require EU-hosted model inference for the POC or just for production?
2) Deletion SLA: when you say "proof of deletion", do you need a signed attestation or an automated API + audit log snapshot?
3) KMS: will Moneta require a customer-managed key (BYOK) for PII in production or is provider KMS acceptable for the POC?

We can attach Redwood's SOC 2 summary and control matrix — see attached "redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf". I'll confirm owners offline with Connor for legal review cadence.

If Tue 5/4 10a PT works we will include Connor and our infra security engineer to walk the deletion and retention flow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@monetasystems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@monetasystems.com>, security@monetasystems.com
Date: 2027-05-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: security & DPA alignment for Redwood POC

Karthik / team — quick follow-up from Moneta security after an internal review:

Inline responses to your clarifying questions:
1) EU residency: For POC, EU residency is NOT required; only production will need EU regions and a separate agreement. For evaluation, synthetic tokens in US infra are fine.
2) Deletion SLA: We are comfortable with an automated API that returns an immutable audit log and a signed attestation at the end of the POC. For production we will require a formal proof-of-deletion runbook and quarterly attestation.
3) KMS: BYOK is preferred for production. POC may use provider-managed KMS with clear key rotation schedule and proof of separation.

Additional asks:
- We would like Redwood to provide a pen-test summary or last third-party pentest date. If you have a SOC 2 auditor contact it helps accelerate our review.
- Data retention windows: Moneta will accept logs retained for 90 days, operational backups retained up to 12 months for POC (we will negotiate longer-term retention at production), and a 30-day buffer for deletion workflows to reflect replication windows.

We will update SIG answers with a few clarifying flags — expecting to post an updated Moneta_SIG_Answers_v1.1 by 2027-05-04.

Regards,
Liam O'Neal
Security Lead
Moneta Systems
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@monetasystems.com>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@monetasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: SUMMARY: Agreed MAP owners, deliverables, and next steps (Moneta POC)

Team — summarizing the MAP items we agreed in-thread and on the intake call earlier today. Please confirm any discrepancies, otherwise we'll convert to a short DocuSign mutual action plan and route the DPA.

Agreed deliverables and owners:
- Redwood SOC 2 packet (owner: Karthik) — deliver by 2027-05-06. Includes auditor contact and control mapping.
- Moneta SIG updated answers (owner: Moneta / Emma) — deliver by 2027-05-04 (Moneta to provide marked-up answers).
- DPA finalization (owner: Connor O'Brien) — Connor to produce final redline disposition by 2027-05-10; target signature by 2027-05-12 via DocuSign.
- Deletion + retention runbook and proof-of-delete demo (owner: Marissa Cole / Redwood Ops) — runbook by 2027-05-08; live demo during POC initial week.
- Pen-test / third-party assessment summary (owner: Redwood security) —deliver summary by 2027-05-07.

Milestones / dates:
- MAP signed: target 2027-05-12 (DocuSign link will be shared HS-5239)
- POC start: 2027-05-15
- POC end & evaluation decision: 2027-06-02

Next steps:
1) Connor will review and respond to the DPA redline by Monday (2027-05-10).
2) I will upload our SOC 2 summary and pen-test notes to the shared drive and link in HubSpot (deal HS-5239).
3) Marissa will schedule the deletion demo into the POC kickoff.

If no objections I will have Connor convert this skeleton into a DocuSign MAP and circulate for signatures.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this on a short approval path.

-Karthik
VP, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
